sections.heading: The setup
sections.body: The S&P 500 sits near the bottom of its past-month range (7,631 vs. a 7,600-7,799 band), and the Nasdaq 100 shows the same pattern (29,077 vs. 28,777-30,085). The VIX is close to its one-month high (16.3 vs. a 14.3-16.5 band), and the Euro Stoxx 50 is sitting at its own one-month low (6,369). This week's earnings load in the core-coverage pool is thin: just 4 events, split between technology (ADBE, SAIL) and single reports from healthcare (COO) and consumer-defensive (KR).

sections.heading: What to watch
sections.body: Four core-coverage names report this week, split across two sessions. Wed: SAIL US and COO US report - SAIL into the technology group (503 tickers, flat +0.23% median) and COO into healthcare (452 tickers, flat +0.11% median). Thu: ADBE US reports into that same technology group, and KR US reports into consumer-defensive, the one sector here running negative (320 tickers, -0.74% median). None of these four sit in this week's hottest sectors - mining, copper, or oil-gas - so it's a quiet week for sector-driven surprises.

sections.heading: Signals to trust
sections.body: Mining leads the reaction table this week at +6.62% median across 160 tickers on 2,627 news items - a thick window.
